description: This Python script demonstrates a voice switching storytelling bot using Pipecat, with pattern matching for voice tags, integration with TTS and STT services, and a language model for storytelling. It sets up pattern-based voice switching, manages a pipeline for streaming text and speech, and handles client connections.

classes.name: PatternPairAggregator
classes.description: A class for pattern-based text processing, specifically for matching and handling pattern tags like voice switches.

classes.name: DeepgramSTTService
classes.description: A class for speech-to-text conversion using Deepgram API.

classes.name: CartesiaTTSService
classes.description: A class for text-to-speech synthesis using Cartesia API.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: A class representing a processing pipeline for streaming data.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: A class representing a task within a pipeline, including configuration and execution.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: A class to run and manage the execution of a pipeline.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: A class managing the context for the language model interactions.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: A class for aggregating LLM context and responses.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the voice switching storytelling bot pipeline.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point to initialize and start the bot with transport.
